customize.text:
<color=#ffd780>About Mualani</color>
In terms of personality, Mualani and Tupac are completely different, and yet both inherited the name, Umoja. Unity lies not in a particular action, but in a state of mind — a willingness to give your all for your nation, family and friends. But, I doubt Mualani was thinking about any of that back then. She knew one thing to be true — that Kachina's life was worth any risk to her own.

customize.text:
Tupac was born into the Metztli tribe over five hundred years ago. He stood out from the crowd due to his enormous height, wielded Hydro, and there was no one in Natlan taller or stronger than him. This mighty giant bore the Ancient Name
Fifteen hundred years earlier, this same name had been borne by Uenuku, who traveled with the first Pyro Archon, Xbalanque. The mountain-like Tupac was always a true hero. Once, in a fit of rage, he shattered mountains with his bare hands and thrust rocks into the earth to make hot springs bubble up. He ventured alone into the sea, battled a two-tailed whale, and tore out the fierce beast's teeth to carry with him.
Among the mighty Tupac's enemies was the young and courageous Tenoch, a man who loved battle, for which he was exiled from the tribe and stripped of his Ancient Name. One day, they fought over a ritual horn belonging to the People of the Springs. Many years later, the giant presented this horn to the Pyro Archon, Haborym, as a gift for Natlan's last hope. During the battles between Tupac and Tenoch, the giant was left with over three hundred scars, twenty broken bones, and over one hundred obsidian shards lodged deep within his body. The giant himself left the hero with two hundred minor wounds, two broken ribs, and an eye that could no longer perceive distance.

Despite his strength and glory, Tupac was sullen, his wild spirit like a dragon trapped in a pool. He dreamed of being born in ancient times, to fight alongside the first Pyro Archon, Xbalanque, against the dragons, or to overthrow the tyrant Och-Kan alongside the hero with the scarlet eyes. The giant decided that if he could bring back the great bones of some titanic beast, or discover some treasures from times bygone, he might not have lived in vain. So, he stepped into the sea's wrathful churn and let the endless currents carry him to parts unknown.
First, he encountered a winged dragon once exiled by a wise king of old, and its wings served as sails to catch the wind. Next came the whale that once drove the waves themselves backward, whose bones the giant used as his white boat. Then came the voracious sea python of the depths, whose fang became Tupac's trusty weapon. After turning that great seabed-dwelling serpent into a delicious meal to go with his drink, he at last reached the edge of the sea. There, the Lord of the Night revealed to the valiant giant that he had been sullen and gloomy because the deathly path had yet been hidden and the dark gate had not revealed itself to him. He was told to hone his flesh and blood and temper his muscle and bone until the day came when the exile, once his foe, would return.

When the Сataclysm began in Teyvat and a dark wave spread across Natlan, the exiled hero Tenoch was the first to rise against the disaster and set out to unite the warring tribes. He gathered five heroes bearing the Ancient Names of Xbalanque's companions, and Tupac was the last to join him. Upon meeting, they recalled all their scars, then burst into riotous laughter, and joined hands. Thus, Tenoch found allies from the six largest tribes, becoming the leader of the united army of Natlan. During the war with the Abyss, the Natlanese calculations estimated that they would have a maximum of five hundred years before the Night Kingdom was completely lost to the Abyss, but at that time, Natlan lay in ruins, and the civilization was dying. It was necessary to unite the tribes, otherwise, it would be impossible to dream of a final victory. So, the Archon had a long and involved discussion with the heroes of each tribe, and finally came up with a five-hundred-year-long plan to save Natlan. During this time, the Archons and chiefs were to rebuild the tribes, and when the time came, the Wayob would once again choose six heroes of Natlan with the Ancient Names of Xbalanque's companions.

During the final battle, where the heroes journeyed with the Archon, the mighty Tupac finally understood his duty. He was the last surviving hero and brought Haborym to the Sacred Flame, so that she could give up her life and be reborn many years later. The Lord of the Night's admonishment rang clearly in his ears, and he witnessed death's door showing itself to him, just as he had once sworn to the deity. As the mighty giant had promised, in his final hope, he raised the flame high and held it until his final breath. And until his final breath, he had not betrayed his oath.
Five hundred years later, when the Pyro Archon was reborn to carry out her plan and new heroes were chosen, Tupac's spirit appeared in the Night Kingdom to his successor, the hero Mualani, and acknowledged her.

<color=#ffffffd9>Since you were able to awaken my words from your Ancient Name, that means you've fully embodied the aspirations of the Wayob.</color>
<color=#ffffffd9>Under the Name 'Umoja,' you shall unite the tribes and save Natlan from its impending doom.</color>
<color=#ffffffd9>"As long as blood still runs through your veins, even the tiniest spark of steel against stone can ignite a flame."</color>
<color=#ffffffd9>"Its blaze will become one with our vision for Natlan."</color>
<color=#ffffffd9>"Even amid everlasting darkness, our bonds remain eternal."</color>
